question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Arun and his friends are like _______________________________________; they always agree on everything.
solution:
The correct answer is '**two peas in a pod**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**two peas in a pod**" is an idiom used to describe people or things that are very similar or always agree with one another.
 
• The sentence implies that Arun and his friends are always in agreement, which aligns perfectly with this idiomatic expression.
